items.detail: In a career spanning over 50 years, Engelbert has generated sales in excess of 140 million records, including 64 gold albums and 35 platinum, four Grammy nominations, a Golden Globe, and stars on the Hollywood Walk of Fame, Las Vegas Walk of Fame, and Leicester Walk of Fame. He has performed for the Queen four times, several presidents and many heads of state. He has recorded everything from the most romantic ballads to movie theme songs, disco, rock, and even gospel. His unique voice has charmed millions of fans around the globe. However, it’s not just the voice, but the man himself, with his endearing sense of humor and self-deprecating jokes. Engelbert has managed to strike a new chord with the younger generation, and his YouTube music videos & social media numbers are incredible. Engelbert exploded on to the music scene with The Beatles and the Rolling Stones. The shy handsome man catapulted almost instantly to world icon. He became great friends with Elvis and the two legends often performed each other’s songs. His first single in the charts was “Release Me,” which went into the Guinness Book of Records for achieving 56 consecutive weeks on the charts. It was No. 1 in 11 countries. Engelbert’s hit song “A Man Without Love” was featured in Marvel’s “Moon Knight” Disney+ Series. In Sony Pictures’ new Brad Pitt film “Bullet Train” Engelbert’s song “Forever Blowing Bubbles” is featured. And in Netflix’s ‘Umbrella Academy” his “Quando, Quando, Quando” is heard. Buy Now
items.title: ENGELBERT HUMPERDINCK: THE CELEBRATION TOUR 2026

items.detail: Jason Bonham always finds himself at home behind the drumkit. From this spot, he has anchored the tempo for a myriad of the most legendary artists of all-time. It’s the place where he initially realized his destiny as a kid. It’s a tried-and-true safe harbor for the expression of his purest emotions. It’s a direct conduit to his late father and Led Zeppelin drummer John Bonham. Following stints with Airrace and Virginia Wolf, he handled drums on Jimmy Page’s gold-certified Outrider. During 1988, he notably accompanied Page, John Paul Jones, and Robert Plant behind the kit for Led Zeppelin at the Atlantic Records 40th Anniversary Celebration Concert. Beyond helming solo projects such as Bonham and The Jason Bonham Band, he appeared in Rock Star with Mark Wahlberg and Jennifer Anniston. Plus, he lent his talents to Foreigner, Little Steven, Joe Bonamassa, and Paul Rodgers. He held down the drums for Led Zeppelin’s 2007 reunion at the Ahmet Ertegun Tribute Concert—which set the Guinness World Record® for “Highest Demand for Tickets for One Music Concert.” The evening spawned the Celebration Day concert film and multiplatinum album, debuting Top 10 on the Billboard 200, selling three million-plus copies, and garnering a GRAMMY®. Other notable projects have included Black Country Communion (Bonamassa, Glenn Hughes, and Derek Sherinian) and California Breed (Hughes and producer and guitarist Andrew Watt). He joined Sammy Hagar and the Circle with Van Halen’s Michael Anthony and Joe Satriani. In 2010, he introduced Jason Bonham’s Led Zeppelin Evening (JBLZE), packing venues coast-to-coast and supporting everyone from Heart to Kid Rock. A spectacle of top-flight musicianship, arresting visuals, mind-blowing lighting, and emotionally charged storytelling, Rolling Stone hailed its “set of Led Zep gems that were strikingly faithful to the originals,” while Billy Joel handpicked JBLZE to open up a handful of dates. Ultimately, Jason remains forever at home on the drums. Buy Now
items.title: JASON BONHAM'S LED ZEPPELIN EVENING

items.detail: GCS brings together three of the most electrifying musicians in modern music: two time Grammy nominated guitarist and vocalist Eric Gales, Modern Drummer Hall of Fame drummer Dennis Chambers, and five time Best Rock Bass Player Billy Sheehan. Each of these musicians has spent decades performing at the highest levels of blues, rock, funk, jazz fusion, soul, and progressive music. Together, they form a rare lineup where every player can lead, listen, and push the music into new territory. The sound of GCS won’t be confined to one category. It will draw from the full range of their musical lives, moving from heavy blues and hard rock to deep funk, soul, and jazz fusion, with room for fearless improvisation and the kind of live interplay that only players of this caliber can deliver. Three legends, three unmistakable musical forces, one stage. When GCS comes to your city, be there to witness what happens when three titans finally join forces. Buy Now Eric Gales: Two time Grammy nominated guitarist, vocalist, and songwriter whose explosive playing has made him one of the most respected artists in modern blues and rock. The Memphis native signed with Elektra Records at 15 and released his debut album at 16, earning Best New Talent honors in Guitar World’s 1991 readers poll. His unmistakable approach, playing a right handed guitar flipped upside down, is matched by a sound that moves naturally through blues, rock, funk, soul, and psychedelia. Across more than three decades, Gales has performed or recorded with artists including Carlos Santana, Buddy Guy, Joe Bonamassa, Gary Clark Jr., Lauryn Hill, and Christone “Kingfish” Ingram. His albums The Bookends and Crown reached No. 1 on Billboard’s Blues Albums chart, while Crown and A Tribute to LJK each earned Grammy nominations for Best Contemporary Blues Album. A three time Blues Music Award winner, Gales also contributed electric guitar to Ludwig Göransson’s Grammy and Academy Award winning score for Sinners. Dennis Chambers: One of the most influential drummers of the modern era, celebrated for his deep pocket, remarkable speed, and ability to make highly technical playing feel completely musical. A self-taught prodigy from Baltimore, Chambers began playing drums at four, was performing in clubs by six, and joined Parliament/Funkadelic at 18. That early foundation in funk became part of a musical language that would eventually reach across jazz, rock, fusion, soul, and Latin music. Dennis has recorded and performed with Carlos Santana, John Scofield, John McLaughlin, George Duke, the Brecker Brothers, Maceo Parker, Mike Stern, and many others. His career also includes playing in the jazz fusion trio Niacin with Billy Sheehan and keyboardist John Novello. Dennis was inducted into the Modern Drummer Hall of Fame in 2001. Over his career he has become one of those rare drummers who can hold down an undeniable groove, drive a band with tremendous power, and take the music completely outside without ever losing its center. Billy Sheehan: one of rock’s most original and influential bassists, known for turning the instrument into both a powerful rhythmic foundation and a commanding lead voice. After building his reputation with the Buffalo power trio Talas, Sheehan joined David Lee Roth’s band alongside Steve Vai and Gregg Bissonette, recording the platinum selling albums Eat ’Em and Smile and Skyscraper. He later co founded Mr. Big, whose worldwide hit “To Be with You” reached No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and topped charts around the world. Sheehan’s career also includes extensive work with Steve Vai, The Winery Dogs, Sons of Apollo, and Niacin with Dennis Chambers and John Novello. His signature style blends deep groove with three finger picking, chords, harmonics, two handed tapping, and controlled feedback. Voted Best Rock Bass Player five times in Guitar Player’s readers poll, Sheehan earned a place in the magazine’s Gallery of Greats.

items.detail: John will be performing his catalogue of hits from his 40-year career as a solo artist, with The Baby’s and Bad English. items.detail: Art Garfunkel is known and celebrated as the “Voice of Generations” in entertainment history. He is an 8x Grammy Award winner including the Grammy Lifetime Achievement Award. In addition, he is a Rock and Roll Hall of Fame inductee and Rolling Stone Magazine names him one of 100 Greatest Singers of All Time. As architect and lead singer of Simon & Garfunkel, he shaped modern popular culture with songs such as “Bridge Over Troubled Water,” “The Sound of Silence,” and “Mrs. Robinson.” His voice defines eras and continues to influence artists and audiences worldwide. Beyond his work leading S & G, Art Garfunkel enjoys a distinguished solo career and a notable body of work as an author, actor, and poet. As a solo artist, he has released a series of acclaimed albums, including Angel Clare, Breakaway, and Watermark, earning chart success and critical recognition for his interpretive depth and signature vocal style. His solo recordings produced enduring favorites such as I Only Have Eyes for You, (What a) Wonderful World, All I Know, and Bright Eyes, the latter becoming an international number one. In 2026, Garfunkel returns to live performances with his new world tour, Art Garfunkel in (What a) Wonderful World, featuring his legendary band. With (What a) Wonderful World, Art Garfunkel returns to the stage with a body of work that continues to speak to resilience, beauty, and shared humanity. Buy Now

items.detail: Deacon Blues was born in the twelfth year of the 21st century. Twelve stellar musicians, composers and educators based in Chicago, they share a unique passion for the Becker/Fagen repository, better known to the world as Steely Dan. Deacon Blues has structured their live repertoire to encompass a wider range of the Dan’s prolific material––all the “hits” are there, but also include rarities as well as repertoire from the Dan’s 1991 reunion prototype––The New York Rock & Soul Revue. In the words of legendary Chicago FM Radio personality Bob Stroud, “If you are a Dan fan, you owe it to yourself to see Deacon Blues — they’ve got all the right musicians with all the right chops — they are an incredible tribute to the music of Steely Dan!” Under the musical leadership of Steven Kikoen & Thomas Linsk, the group reads as a “who’s who” of world-class musicians. Chicago luminaries and Grammy® winners are either permanent members of the group and/or award-winning featured guests – among them Howard Levy (Kenny Loggins, Paul Simon, Béla Fleck); Paul Wertico (Pat Metheny, Wertico, Cain, & Gray, Time Zone); Richard Patterson (Miles Davis, Michael McDonald, Boz Scaggs, Time Zone); Corky Siegel (Chamber Blues); Ben Johnson & Charles Heath IV (Ramsey Lewis); Wally Hustin (Phoebe Snow, Dave Mason, Mark Stern, David Benoit); Chuck Webb (Aretha Franklin, Ramsey Lewis, & Al Di Meola); Sugar Blue (The Rolling Stones); Billy Branch (The Sons of Blues); Khari Parker (George Benson, Destiny’s Child); Ben Lewis (Gary Sinise’s Lt. dan Band, Ben Lewis Trio, Time Zone); Vijay Tellis-Nayak (Prognosis, Big Suit, Michael Shannon & Jason Narducy and Friends); Cash Michaels (Time Zone); Rich Lapka (Soul Daddy); Victor Garcia (award-winning trumpeter), Thaddeus Tukes (award-winning world-renowned vibraphonist); Char McAllister (Char Dreams); Suzanne Cross (Soul Daddy); Pamela Rose (Encore 33); Elisa Latrice (Simply The Best–Tina Turner); Sally Blandon (Tears dry On Their Own–Amy Winehouse); Jessica Vasilou (Petty Union); and Andrea Miologos (My Weekend Crush). Buy Now –– AWARD-WINNING SPECIAL GUESTS AT THIS CONCERT –– BILLY BRANCH Billy Branch is an Emmy Award winner, a 3-Time Grammy® Award nominee, and a retired Grammy® governor. He’s won multiple Blues Music Awards (B.M.A.s), most recently winning both the 2026 Best Harmonica Instrumentalist Award and the 2026 Living Blues Critics’ Award. Billy is also a proud recipient of multiple B.M.A. Keeping the Blues Alive Awards for his 45-year-old Blues in the Schools program. In addition to his numerous humanitarian awards, Branch is most proud of being a 2020 inductee into the Blues Foundation’s Blues Hall of Fame Museum in Memphis. Branch is on the Board of Directors of both the Blues Foundation and the Little Walter Foundation, and is a recipient of an Addy Award — like an Oscar for TV ads — for his on-screen commercial work. Billy’s recording with Dave Spector is included in the Grammy Museum’s Woody Guthrie installation entitled Songs of Conscience, Sounds of Freedom. Billy is an honored recipient of the 2026 Mellon Foundation’s Taproot Artists & Community Trust Alliance Fellowship, recognizing him as an American Culture-Bearer. He used part of that award to fund a daytime senior citizens’ Blues event on the Southside of Chicago, a Blues in the Schools concert for 500 Chicago students, and a community concert featuring his new album, The Blues Is My Biography. BERNARD “PRETTY” PURDIE Original Steely Dan session musician and legendary drummer Bernard “Pretty” Purdie has appeared with Deacon Blues at several of their Arcada and Des Plaines Theatre shows. Native New Jersey resident, legendary drummer and teacher, Bernard is an 84-year-old veteran of the music scene, who started his expansive career with Country Music and went on to Blues, Jazz, Classic Rock, Pop, R & B, and Funk. Bernard has worked with over 2,500 artists and played on over 4,000 records. Bernard’s music finds its roots in the rhythmic sounds of the B&O Railroad trains while growing up in Elkton, Maryland. These roots have taken him around the world, playing, recording, and capturing the sounds and rhythms of the world. Bernard has played every genre of music to thousands of well received audiences. Bernard’s live work with his band “Bernard Purdie and Friends” in New Jersey featuring Dan Boone, George Naha, Miho Nobuzane-Elijah and frontman Rob Paparozzi has touched the hearts and souls of audiences all around the world. He also has a newly formed band in North Carolina called The Purdie Boys who are Bernard, Chuck Phillips, Bruce Clark & Jesus Vega; rounding out the band are Jim Barbee, Rich Dimetre and Josh Mineer. Bernard’s work on Broadway & TV Music from the 60’s through the 80’s has left its mark on the Great White Way. His credits include Hair, Two Gentlemen of Verona, and 16 plays by Galt MacDermot. At 84 years of age, he shows no sign of stopping. Bernard Purdie revolutionized drumming with his invention of “The Purdie Shuffle” – inspiring legions and generations of drummers over lo these many years. Bernard has been on more Steely Dan records than any other drummer in history – enjoy the great Bernard Purdie!
items.title: AN EVENING WITH DEACON BLUES: STEELY DAN TRIBUTE

items.detail: The Niles Metropolitan Chorus has been bringing great music to Chicago’s northern suburbs for over 10 years. Specializing in the art of the oratorio, these singers are dedicated to bringing to life great music of all periods and styles. Artistic Director Marek Rachelski conducts Handel’s MESSIAH from the harpsichord as he leads the Chorus, Musica Lumina Orchestra and professional soloists through the First Part (Advent/Christmas portion) with an added bonus of several more arias and choruses including the famous HALLELUJAH CHORUS. Bring out the family and begin a new holiday tradition! NMC has accomplished milestones since its debut in 2013 including performing at Chicago’s Orchestra Hall in 2019, collaborating with the Chicago Bar Association Symphony Orchestra and Chorus and the DePaul Community Chorus. NMC has proudly showcased works of Beethoven, Bruckner, Gounod, Mendelssohn, Rutter, Saint-Saëns, the Requiems of Cherubini, Mozart, and Faure, Haydn’s Creation, a yearly Handel’s Messiah, and the Passions of St. John and St. Matthew of J.S. Bach. The Musica Lumina Orchestra offers a separate series of programs from chamber music to full orchestra sure to delight any audience. To discover more information please visit: www.nilesmetropolitanchorus.com. Buy Now

items.detail: In the past few years Cherry Poppin’ Daddies have become the kind of band that you would want to book if you were throwing a soiree at the Gatsby mansion. Penning elegant, lush, pitch perfect arrangements of much of the great American songbook, from Cole Porter to Frank Sinatra, the Daddies have surprised many- likely familiar with them from the early 90’s- whose limited exposure to the band undoubtedly consists of an image of spray painted vans careening across the US as an iconoclastic, misfit part of an already marginalized punk/ska scene. The WWII “Christmas Canteen” show is part Tiki, part Benny Goodman and comes across like a radio broadcast from Guadalcanal circa 1942. Initially rooted in the underground punk scene, the Cherry Poppin’ Daddies made waves with their unique fusion of swing-era jazz and modern rock elements. They fluidly navigate a range of styles, from the big band swing sound of Zoot Suit Riot to the ska-punk of albums like Kids on the Street and Rapid City Muscle Car. With roots in alternative and punk rock, the Daddies have always pushed boundaries, creating music that feels fresh and innovative. Their ability to seamlessly blend vintage swing with modern genres like ska and rock has allowed them to stand out in a crowded musical landscape, while appealing to a wide variety of listeners. The Flat Cats, based in Chicago, IL, play a range of vintage and modern music rooted in the hottest swinging jazz and blues, contemporary classics, and timeless standards. Whether you choose to listen, tap your foot, or cut a rug on the dance floor, you are sure to be entertained! The group is comprised of six talented musicians with years of performing, arranging, and composing experience. Buy Now

items.detail: Lou Gramm is best known as the original lead vocalist of the rock band Foreigner. With his powerful, soaring voice, he helped define the band’s arena-rock sound in the late 1970s and 1980s. As Foreigner’s frontman, Gramm sang on major hits such as “Cold as Ice,” “Hot Blooded,” “Urgent,” “Juke Box Hero,” and the global No. 1 ballad “I Want to Know What Love Is.” He also pursued a successful solo career, scoring hits like “Midnight Blue” and “Just Between You and Me.” Gramm left Foreigner in 1990, rejoined briefly in the 1990s, and was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame as a member of Foreigner in 2024. He remains celebrated as one of classic rock’s most distinctive voices. Fran Cosmo exploded onto the Rock scene when he took over for Brad Delp as the lead singer for the Legendary group BOSTON in 1992. Fran was featured as the lead vocalist on the “Walk On” album and produced the hit single “I Need Your Love”. Upon Brad Delp’s return to BOSTON, Fran Cosmo and Brad Delp shared lead vocals and harmonized exceptionally well in concert, wowing their fans on tours, and always having a fun time trading the spotlight together on stage. Fran Cosmo was a member of BOSTON and toured with them from 1992 to 2006. Joining Fran on stage with be Kevin Chalfant (performed as lead signer of The Storm and Journey). Buy Now

items.detail: Steve Fossen and Michael Derosier, bassist and drummer for the band Heart during the 1970s and early 1980s, are now touring as Heart By Heart. “Our mission is to perform the classic Heart music as faithfully as we can,” Fossen says. The band features vocalist Somar Macek, guitarist/keyboardist/vocalist Lizzy Daymont and guitarist Chad Quist. Heart By Heart presents a powerful, dynamic show that includes all the favorite Heart hits as well as deep album cuts that fans will love. Fossen and Derosier are the powerful driving engine behind Heart’s classic hits like “Barracuda”, “Straight On”, “Crazy On You”, “Magic Man”, “Even It Up”, “Dog & Butterfly”, “Heartless”, “Kick It Out”, and more. First formed by Steve Fossen in 1969, Heart went on to release six top-10 albums and landed 20 hit singles on the Billboard top 40 chart. In recognition of their contributions to these iconic recordings, and to Heart’s first seven years of national and international touring, Fossen and Derosier were inducted into The Rock & Roll Hall of Fame with the rest of the original Heart lineup in 2013. items.detail: They Sing. They String. They Shred!!! FEMMES OF ROCK is a high-octane, multimedia rock experience that redefines the electric violin. Fronted by three powerhouse female violinist/vocalists and backed by a thunderous three-piece band, this show takes classic rock and heavy metal to a level you’ve never seen—or heard—before. From Queen, Led Zeppelin, Pink Floyd, and Ozzy to Van Halen, AC/DC, Guns N’ Roses, Metallica, Rush, Lynyrd Skynyrd, The Allman Brothers, The Who, and beyond, FEMMES OF ROCK tears through legendary anthems with jaw-dropping precision and fire. You won’t believe it’s violins driving the sound until you see it for yourself. At the helm is Nina DiGregorio, leader and founder of FEMMES OF ROCK, hailed as the Eddie Van Halen of the violin—blazing with the virtuosity of a guitar hero and the swagger of true rock ’n’ roll. Her recent viral video has exploded past 35 million views worldwide, cementing her as a trailblazer redefining what the violin can do. FEMMES OF ROCK has shared stages with legends like Ted Nugent, Kansas, Cheap Trick, Daughtry, Bad Company, Michael McDonald, Charlie Daniels and more…leaving audiences across the country electrified. Nina’s talent has drawn praise from rock royalty: • Ivan Moody (Five Finger Death Punch): “Next Level.” • Richie Sambora (Bon Jovi): “This girl is amazing. Way to go, Nina.” • Michael Anthony (Van Halen): “You rock it, girl. Nina, you’re killing it.” • Kathy Rhoads (sister of Randy Rhoads): “I always said my brother’s guitar sings and sounds like a violin. He would love this.” Hersteria pours some extra sugar on Def Leppard’s legendary rock anthems, elevating each classic hit with their own electrifying flair. With powerhouse vocals that channel the unmistakable energy of Joe Elliott and electrifying guitar riffs reminiscent of Phil Collen and Steve Clark, these talented women deliver performances that are both authentic and exhilarating. Their dynamic stage presence captivates audiences from the first chord, blending tight harmonies and blistering solos with visually stunning choreography and vibrant lighting that amplify every note. The rhythm section drives the music forward with precision and passion, ensuring that each song resonates with the same intensity that made Def Leppard a rock powerhouse. Whether it’s the soaring melodies of “Pour Some Sugar on Me” or the anthemic choruses of “Love Bites,” Hersteria brings a fresh yet faithful interpretation that keeps fans on their feet, ready to bang their heads and rock out all night long. With their undeniable talent and infectious enthusiasm, Hersteria is NOT foolin’ around—they’re dedicated to delivering unforgettable performances that honor the spirit and legacy of one of rock’s greatest bands.
